Flu season is approaching, and consumers are actively researching symptoms, treatments, wellness solutions, and household essentials. Proximic’s AI-driven contextual and predictive audiences help brands identify where health-related intent is emerging, enabling them to reach flu-fighters, caregivers, wellness shoppers, and health-conscious consumers at the moments that matter most. Download the guide to explore ready-to-activate audiences and customizable solutions designed to drive stronger outcomes throughout the flu season.
